Textual Amendments
F21 S. 6B inserted (prosp.) by Criminal Justice Act 2003 (c. 44), ss. 33(3), 336
[F226C Notification of intention to call defence witnesses

(1) The accused must give to the court and the prosecutor a notice indicating whether he
intends to call any persons (other than himself) as witnesses at his trial and, if so—
(a) giving the name, address and date of birth of each such proposed witness, or
as many of those details as are known to the accused when the notice is given;
(b) providing any information in the accused’s possession which might be of
material assistance in identifying or finding any such proposed witness in
whose case any of the details mentioned in paragraph (a) are not known to the
accused when the notice is given.
